commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tobias Welz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' 2 - 0 What a hit that is! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) scores a great goal from approximately 40 metres out. His low effort goes straight into the middle of the goal and he makes it 2:0.
90+5' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+3' Yannik Keitel (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Welz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+2' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) jumps into a tackle and Tobias Welz signals a foul. FC Koln win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:8.
84' Lukas Kwasniok prepares a substitution. Tom Krauss is replaced by Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln).

84' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. It's a free kick to FC Koln in a dangerous position.
82' Substitution. Robin Fellhauer did his best and is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
82' The substitution has been made. Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) has replaced Han-Noah Massengo.
82' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Anton Kade (Augsburg) replaces Mert Komur.
81' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
78' Substitution. Jahmai Simpson-Pusey walks off the pitch and Felipe Chavez (1. FC Koln) comes on as a substitute.
77' The referee signals a corner kick to FC Koln.
77' The ball is out of play and FC Koln manage to earn a corner.

76' Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Finn Dahmen. Corner kick. FC Koln will have an opportunity.
75' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) steps up to send the ball in.
75' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
75' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
74' The attendance for today's match is 30660.
71' Fouls committed – 12:3.
68' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Ribeiro.
67' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Marius Bulter and he is replaced by Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln).
66' Luca Waldschmidt goes off the pitch and Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) comes on.
66' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
65' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

65' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Marvin Schwabe has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

60' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln). He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
57' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

57' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
55' 1 - 0 GOAL! Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Noahkai Banks provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:0.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. FC Koln are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
50' Manuel Baum is forced to make a change. Kristijan Jakic is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Yannik Keitel (Augsburg).
49' The game is interrupted now, Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' FC Koln force their opponents to concede a corner.

48' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen is prepared and dives to thwart him. FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
46' Lukas Kwasniok makes a switch. Isak Johannesson is coming on in place of Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Mert Komur (Augsburg) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
42' Surely that's handball by one of the FC Koln players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

41' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.

38' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) jumps high inside the box to connect with the resulting corner, but his bullet header smashes against the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
37' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
36' FC Koln win a corner.
36' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. FC Koln earn a corner.
36' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.

35' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent. That's a free kick to FC Koln.
34' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Augsburg.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln). Tobias Welz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

28' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
24' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mert Komur (Augsburg) heads on.
23' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg. Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) tries to find Luca Waldschmidt, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
21' 65:35 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
17' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) picks up a yellow card.
14' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:1.
11' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

10' A neat pass is well received by Noahkai Banks (Augsburg), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
10' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
8' The linesman points to the corner flag, FC Koln are going to take it.

7' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Augsburg.
6' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.

5' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
3' Wonderful movement by FC Koln. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Tobias Welz will referee today's match.
